normative_extracts.quote: Size containment on the inline axis breaks the parent-child sizing cycle required for container queries.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: inline-size containment allows @container rules to resolve in a single top-down pass.

production_failures.root_cause: container-type: inline-size prevents the parent from sizing to its children's intrinsic width.
production_failures.mitigation: Define an explicit width (width: 100% or flex: 1) on the container.

production_failures.symptom: @container rule ignored on a nested component
production_failures.root_cause: An intermediate wrapper also declares container-type without a container-name.
production_failures.mitigation: Name critical containers explicitly with container-name.
